3446 morphosis {mor'-fo-sis}

from 3445; TDNT - 4:754,607; n f

AV - form 2; 2

1) a forming, shaping
2) form
   2a) the mere form, semblance
   2b) the form befitting a thing or truly expressing the fact,
       the very form
